author: ljuckett
body: ## Description Previously in phase 2 tk DQM histograms could only easily be booked at the top level (whole IT or OT) or the "deepest" level (individual rings, wheels, and layers). This PR adds a way to book histograms at every "depth" of the tracker without having to manually navigate folder structure or create extra if statements at the filling stage. ## "Depth" system When booking a histogram, the depth must be specified. By default, histograms will be booked at every depth. ``` if (bookingDepth == ENDCAP_WHEEL) { local_mes.XY_byWheel = phase2tkutil::book2DFromPSet(config_.getParameter("XY_byWheel"), ibooker, prettyName); } ``` When booking the histogram, the depth and substructure does not need to be checked. It only needs to be checked that _the histogram exists_. ``` if (local_mes.XY_byWheel) local_mes.XY_byWheel->Fill(gx, gy); ``` There are 6 depth levels corresponding to different structures: | Depth | Inner Tracker Structure | Outer Tracker Structure | | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | InnerTracker | OuterTracker | | 2 | Barrel, forward, or endcap | Barrel or endcap | | 3 | Shell/Half-cylinder | (Endcaps only) Side | | 4 | (Endcaps only) Ring | (Endcaps only) Ring | | 5 | (Endcaps only) Wheel | (Endcaps only) Wheel | | 6 | Barrel layer OR ring in wheel | Barrel layer OR ring in wheel | To demonstrate the depth system at various levels, three new histograms are added to ITClusters: ``` MonitorElement* ClusterPos_Mod_Ladder = nullptr; // Only in Barrel and LAYER MonitorElement* XY_byWheel = nullptr; // Only in ENDCAP_WHEEL std::vector ClusterPos_BLayer_Mod_Ladder; // Only in Barrel and SUBSTRUCTURE ``` ## getHistoId This function gets either the filepath or "pretty name" for a detid. The function gets all the postition data (Substructure, side, layer, etc) and uses the depth to figure out which parts to include in the output. Note that the topFolder of "InnerTracker" or "OuterTracker" is determined by the individual DQM plugins. Example filepath output, depth 4: > /Endcaps/EndcapPix/mI/Ring1 Example pretty output, depth 4: > IT endcap EPix shell mI Ring1 The pretty output can be used in histogram titles to make sharing screenshots of histograms more helpful: ## General changes 1. Improved some histogram labels & removed params for unused histograms 2. Used phase2tkutil parameter set & booking functions where possible 3. Removed CRACK-specific plugin config files, CRACK config is now in "regular" config 4. Overhaul of TTCluster and TTStub to handle histograms in the same way as other TkDQM plugins 5. "Counter" histograms now work more intuitively 6. Fixed some bugs and removed magic numbers 7. Validation: removed uses of old getITHistoID and getOTHistoID ## DQM output size increase of a lot But it is necessary to be able to monitor at every level. #### TODO Double check all bin sizes (L1Stub Offset by wheel wrong) Write readme Look at OTCluster Ladder histogram
title: Tracker DQM: Add histogram booking at multiple levels
